description: This source file defines classes and extension methods related to Consul clustering integration within Orleans. It includes options classes, validators, utility extension methods for host builders, and some runtime data classes for silo registration and membership management.

classes.name: ConsulClusteringOptions
classes.description: Options class for configuring Consul clustering with methods to create clients and set KvRootFolder.

classes.name: ConsulClusteringOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validator class for ConsulClusteringOptions to validate configuration.

classes.name: ConsulSiloRegistration
classes.description: Runtime data class representing a silo registration in Consul with properties like hostname, silo name, status, etc.

classes.name: SuspectingSilo
classes.description: Runtime class representing a silo suspected of failure, with an ID and timestamp.

classes.name: ConsulBasedMembershipTable
classes.description: Implements IMembershipTable for membership management using Consul.

classes.name: ConsulGatewayListProvider
classes.description: Provides gateway list information for Orleans clustering via Consul.

methods.name: ConfigureConsulClient
methods.description: Configures the Consul client using a callback or URI.

methods.name: UseConsulClientClustering
methods.description: Extension methods to configure Orleans client builder with Consul clustering.

methods.name: UseConsulSiloClustering
methods.description: Extension methods to configure Orleans silo builder with Consul clustering.
